title: The Four Elements in the Body and the Two Endings
description: The four elements are pure from the beginning, belonging to luminaries and saints, but were mingled in the first contest. Bound to the Cross of Light in bodies, they shed a graded series of "defiled garments" (bond → wrath → desire → bitterness → heat → flesh → gloom → severity, summed as twelve strippings). Two endings: purified in the New Man's living icon they ascend to first rest; multiplied with sin in the unregenerate body they pass into metensomatosis under sentence.
